desc:
⚠️LIKE THE GAME AND JOIN THE GROUP FOR REWARDS!⚠️

HOW TO PLAY:
☁️ Jump across floating clouds high in the sky!
⚠️ Stay focused… one wrong step and you fall into the void!
💰 Grab Brainrots and bring them back safely to your Base to earn Cash!
🚀 Upgrade your Jumps & Speed to reach farther clouds and survive longer!

💤 Your Brainrots earn cash OFFLINE! 💤
